scene_purpose: Run the four branch baselines, establish that each individual elemental model behaves correctly, and expose only a small residual/relationship trace after all four have validated.

current_floor_state.branch_result: all four individual branches validate as expected
current_floor_state.residual_timing: small combined overlay trace appears only after all four baselines are known
current_floor_state.residual_meaning: unexplained relationship/whole-system clue; not proof of Seventh Reaction or hidden element
current_floor_state.wayfinder: broad structural resemblance only; no long map discussion

allowed_information_transfers: Vaelira may state that branch-level evidence supports her branch models.
The residual may motivate pair testing but cannot be named as the final mechanism.
No dialogue during active combat/hazards; use authored stops.
No Wind, Water, fifth element, seventh element, or new damage type.

attention: what a correct result does and does not rule out
avoidances: technical vocabulary she does not own
record exposition unrelated to the tests

attention: whether each branch reproduces expected behavior
what remains after correct branch behavior is accounted for
avoidances: discarding the residual because the branches passed
